description: T-5123 (T-3739): #This Row references inside their own table through a whole-column delete of column A, left of the table (it moves whole to A3:C7). Do the moved formula cells keep their =[@Qty]*2 text? A column of =Sales[@Qty]*2 formulas (stored Sales[[#This Row],[Qty]]*2) inside the table (S!D4:D7, header D3 Dbl; Sales on S!B3:D7, Qty 1,2,4,8; table-insert-row-calc-column-above-header's layout). F!A1:A4 FORMULATEXT of the four formula cells (the references follow the moved cells) and B1:B4 their values; A5/B5 and A6/B6 the text and value at the fixed addresses S!C4 and S!C7 (INDIRECT, not adjusted): the first and last formula cells after the edit; A7 =SUM(Sales[Dbl]), A8 =ROWS(Sales).
